title: coprosmanthus peduncularis
intro: Coprosmanthus peduncularis, commonly known as the Chinese boxwood or Chinese box, is a plant species native to China. It is a type of shrub that belongs to the family Ericaceae. The health benefits of Coprosmanthus peduncularis include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Coprosmanthus peduncularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
